CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an explicit origin/organization field, and separate content lines are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented content and attributes (red/blue) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Content entries are provided separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referents/times.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/inheritance/command_estimate fields state how content is organized/presented/accessed (including inherited/current/copy origins).
